questions.solution:

• **Example:** The puny seedlings struggled to survive in the harsh conditions.
 
 
 
• **Celibate** (ब्रह्मचारी): Abstaining from marriage and sexual relations, often for religious reasons.
 
 
• **Example:** He chose to live a celibate life dedicated to his spiritual practice.
